name: Goalfer
subtitle: Social Habit Tracking
description:
Transform your life with Goalfer - the social habit tracker that helps you build lasting routines through accountability, motivation, and community support.

🎯 BUILD HABITS THAT STICK
• Beautiful habit tracking with visual progress circles
• Smart streak counting and milestone celebrations
• 39+ habit categories: fitness, wellness, productivity, creativity
• Offline support with seamless cloud sync
• Customizable reminders and notifications

👥 SOCIAL ACCOUNTABILITY THAT WORKS
• Connect with friends for mutual motivation
• Real-time activity feed showing friends' progress
• Encourage friends with emoji reactions (❤️🔥🏅)
• Privacy controls - share what you want, when you want
• Friend challenges and group motivation

📊 INSIGHTS THAT INSPIRE
• Comprehensive analytics and progress charts
• Streak statistics and personal achievement records
• Weekly and monthly progress summaries
• Trend analysis to optimize your routine
• Achievement badges and milestone tracking

✨ WHY GOALFER WORKS:
• Social accountability helps you stay consistent
• Beautiful, intuitive design makes tracking effortless
• Proven habit formation techniques built-in
• Community support when motivation is low
• Privacy-first approach - your data stays yours

🏆 PERFECT FOR:
• Fitness routines and workout consistency
• Wellness practices like meditation and journaling
• Productivity habits and skill development
• Creative projects and learning goals
• Daily self-care and mindfulness practices

Join others building better habits with Goalfer. Download now and start building the habits that will change everything!

⭐ GOALFER PRO
• Track up to 15 habits (Free includes 6)
• Monthly or annual plans
• More Pro features on the way — Pro members get every new one as we ship it

🎉 FOUNDING MEMBERS: Our first 100 users get Goalfer Pro free for life. Sign up early to claim your spot.

🔒 Privacy & Security: Your data is encrypted and secure. We never sell your information. Full privacy controls included.
